key: \PN!
en: \PN!
ja: \PN!

en: FERN: I know what I said before, but I didn't think YOU, of all people, would actually make it this far.
ja: ファーン: 前に言ったこと覚えてるけど、よりによってあんたがここまで来るなんて思ってなかった。

en: Gotta be honest, it's genuinely impressive,
ja: 正直、素直に感心するよ、

en: Just how consistently you've cheated and lucked your way forward.
ja: ずっと一貫してズルと運だけで前に進んできたんだから。

en: FERN: You remember what I said back at the school?
ja: ファーン: 学校で言ったこと覚えてる?

key: Someone like you doesn't deserve to move forward here.
en: Someone like you doesn't deserve to move forward here.
ja: あんたみたいな奴が先に進む資格なんてない。

key: What've you done, huh?
en: What've you done, huh?
ja: あんた、何かしたわけ?

key: Forget accomplishments-- why do YOU deserve it more than anyone else?!
en: Forget accomplishments-- why do YOU deserve it more than anyone else?!
ja: 実績なんて忘れよう――なんであんたが誰よりもそれに値するっていうの?!

key: Can you really answer that?
en: Can you really answer that?
ja: それに答えられる?

key: Can you look me in the eyes and tell me why,
en: Can you look me in the eyes and tell me why,
ja: わたしの目を見て言える?

key: No matter how hard anyone tries,
en: No matter how hard anyone tries,
ja: 誰がどれだけ頑張っても、

key: YOU get to be the one to step on them?
en: YOU get to be the one to step on them?
ja: あんたが踏みつける側になれる理由を?

key: If it's gotta be someone, it should be me.
en: If it's gotta be someone, it should be me.
ja: 誰かがそうならなきゃいけないなら、それはわたしのはず。

key: "What right do you have?" you might ask.
en: "What right do you have?" you might ask.
ja: 「あんたに何の権利があるんだ」って聞くかもね。

key: To which I say,
en: To which I say,
ja: それに対する答えは、

key: Fuck off.
en: Fuck off.
ja: くたばれ。

en: FLORINIA: Fern.
ja: フロリニア: ファーン。

key: FERN: You stay out of this, Flobot!
en: FERN: You stay out of this, Flobot!
ja: ファーン: あんたは黙ってて、フロボット!

key: This is between me and \PN,
en: This is between me and \PN,
ja: これはわたしと\PNの問題、

key: And no one else.
en: And no one else.
ja: 他の誰でもない。

key: I'll beat you here and take the rest of your badges for myself!
en: I'll beat you here and take the rest of your badges for myself!
ja: ここであんたを倒して、残りのバッジを全部いただくから!

key: WHY DOES IT HAVE TO BE YOU?!
en: WHY DOES IT HAVE TO BE YOU?!
ja: なんで　テメーなんかに!!

key: FERN: It should've been me...
en: FERN: It should've been me...
ja: ファーン: わたしのはずだった…

key: It should've been--
en: It should've been--
ja: そうであるべきだった――

key: It should still be...
en: It should still be...
ja: 今だってそうであるべき…

key: But YOU got in the way!
en: But YOU got in the way!
ja: なのにあんたが邪魔したの!

key: FERN: WHAT?!
en: FERN: WHAT?!
ja: ファーン: 何?!

key: What do you want, you stupid doll?
en: What do you want, you stupid doll?
ja: 何なのよ、このバカ人形。

key: FLORINIA: I am not a doll.
en: FLORINIA: I am not a doll.
ja: フロリニア: 私は人形ではありません。

key: Nor am I a robot.
en: Nor am I a robot.
ja: ロボットでもありません。

key: I have feelings, and I've run from them.
en: I have feelings, and I've run from them.
ja: 私には感情があり、それから逃げてきました。

key: And it will take a lot more experimentation and research until I am able to fully receive or understand them.
en: And it will take a lot more experimentation and research until I am able to fully receive or understand them.
ja: それを完全に受け入れ、理解できるようになるまでには、まだ多くの実験と研究が必要でしょう。

key: But like fermions, bosons and everything else, one can be sure they are there.
en: But like fermions, bosons and everything else, one can be sure they are there.
ja: ですが、フェルミオンやボソン、その他あらゆるものと同じように、それが存在することは確かです。

key: FERN: Believe me, I care deeply.
en: FERN: Believe me, I care deeply.
ja: ファーン: 信じてよ、すっごく気にかけてるから。

key: FLORINIA: This speaker is not a doll.
en: FLORINIA: This speaker is not a doll.
ja: フロリニア: この話者は人形ではありません。

key: FERN: You sure resemble one.
en: FERN: You sure resemble one.
ja: ファーン: どう見ても人形にしか見えないけど。

key: FLORINIA: Your behavior is irrational.
en: FLORINIA: Your behavior is irrational.
ja: フロリニア: あなたの行動は不合理です。

key: It is suggested to withdraw from the present conflict at once.
en: It is suggested to withdraw from the present conflict at once.
ja: 直ちに現在の争いから撤退することを提案します。

key: FERN: That's what I thought.
en: FERN: That's what I thought.
ja: ファーン: そんなことだと思った。

key: Everyone's just against me.
en: Everyone's just against me.
ja: みんなわたしの敵。

key: You always have been.
en: You always have been.
ja: あんたもずっとそうだった。

key: FLORINIA: Incorrect.
en: FLORINIA: Incorrect.
ja: フロリニア: 違います。

key: FERN: Where's your fucking evidence, huh?
en: FERN: Where's your fucking evidence, huh?
ja: ファーン: 証拠はどこにあるわけ、ああ?

key: You never cared back then, and even now you're still here trying to stop me!
en: You never cared back then, and even now you're still here trying to stop me!
ja: あの頃は全然気にかけてくれなかったくせに、今になってわたしを止めようとしてる!

key: And you just snatched the place right up!
en: And you just snatched the place right up!
ja: しかもあんたはあの場所をさっさと奪っていった!

key: You wanna know why I should be the one to finish the league?
en: You wanna know why I should be the one to finish the league?
ja: なんでリーグを終わらせるのがわたしじゃなきゃいけないか知りたい?

key: Because then, maybe--
en: Because then, maybe--
ja: だってそうしたら、もしかして――

key: Just fucking maybe--
en: Just fucking maybe--
ja: ほんとに、もしかしたら――

key: If I were the champion,
en: If I were the champion,
ja: わたしがチャンピオンになれたら、

key: Maybe someone would actually smile at me.
en: Maybe someone would actually smile at me.
ja: もしかしたら誰かが本当にわたしに笑いかけてくれるかもしれない。

key: Yeah?
en: Yeah?
ja: でしょ?

key: Cuz no one ever bothered to.
en: Cuz no one ever bothered to.
ja: だって今まで誰もそんなことしてくれなかったから。

key: Our parents sure didn't.
en: Our parents sure didn't.
ja: 親だってそうだった。

key: Anything I did well, she got the credit for.
en: Anything I did well, she got the credit for.
ja: わたしが何かうまくやっても、あの子の手柄になった。

key: And anything she did wrong, I got the blame for.
en: And anything she did wrong, I got the blame for.
ja: あの子が何か失敗したら、わたしが責められた。

key: Flobot would never smile.
en: Flobot would never smile.
ja: フロボットは絶対に笑わなかった。

key: She actually used to, you know that?
en: She actually used to, you know that?
ja: 昔は本当に笑ってたって、知ってた?

key: You believe it?
en: You believe it?
ja: 信じられる?

key: But not at me.
en: But not at me.
ja: でも、わたしにはじゃない。

key: Never at me.
en: Never at me.
ja: わたしには一度も。

key: The other students--
en: The other students--
ja: 他の生徒には――

key: I wasn't always top of the pack.
en: I wasn't always top of the pack.
ja: わたしはずっとトップだったわけじゃない。

key: More like the rock bottom of it.
en: More like the rock bottom of it.
ja: むしろどん底だった。

key: But I fixed that.
en: But I fixed that.
ja: でも、それを変えた。

key: I learned to persevere,
en: I learned to persevere,
ja: 耐え抜くことを覚えた、

key: To TAKE control.
en: To TAKE control.
ja: 主導権を握ることを。

key: But when you're at the top, then they don't smile for a different reason.
en: But when you're at the top, then they don't smile for a different reason.
ja: でも上に立つと、今度は別の理由でみんな笑わなくなる。

key: They're too afraid.
en: They're too afraid.
ja: 怖がりすぎてるから。

key: Everyone's a fucking coward.
en: Everyone's a fucking coward.
ja: みんな臆病者ばっかり。

key: What does it cost, huh?
en: What does it cost, huh?
ja: 何を犠牲にするっていうの?

key: To make another person feel like they aren't just the scum of the earth?
en: To make another person feel like they aren't just the scum of the earth?
ja: 誰かに、自分がただのクズじゃないって感じさせてあげるのに。

key: That's why even now, I try to face a challenge with a smile!
en: That's why even now, I try to face a challenge with a smile!
ja: だから今だって、わたしは笑顔で挑戦に立ち向かおうとしてる!

key: And if I can't--
en: And if I can't--
ja: それができないなら――

key: Then I just have to make something worth smiling about!
en: Then I just have to make something worth smiling about!
ja: 笑うに値するものを、自分で作り出すしかない!

key: Lin could do that.
en: Lin could do that.
ja: リンならそれができた。

key: Better than anyone else can.
en: Better than anyone else can.
ja: 誰よりもうまく。

key: God knows there's too little in this world that's worth it,
en: God knows there's too little in this world that's worth it,
ja: この世界に、その価値があるものなんてほとんどないんだから、

key: Or none of us would even be here right now.
en: Or none of us would even be here right now.
ja: でなきゃ、わたしたちは誰もここにいないはず。

key: LIN: That is correct.
en: LIN: That is correct.
ja: リン: その通り。

key: LIN: In this world, all things operate within scarcity.
en: LIN: In this world, all things operate within scarcity.
ja: リン: この世界では、すべてのものが欠乏の中で機能している。

key: Resources are finite.
en: Resources are finite.
ja: 資源は有限。

key: Space and time are finite.
en: Space and time are finite.
ja: 空間も時間も有限。

key: Compassion is finite.
en: Compassion is finite.
ja: 思いやりすらも有限。

key: This is the world once birthed by Arceus of its own will.
en: This is the world once birthed by Arceus of its own will.
ja: これはかつてアルセウスが自らの意志で生み出した世界。

key: This is not a world that must be accepted.
en: This is not a world that must be accepted.
ja: これは受け入れなければならない世界ではない。

key: With a wisdom that both humans and Arceus lacked so long ago, we can guide creation to a world where these limits need not apply.
en: With a wisdom that both humans and Arceus lacked so long ago, we can guide creation to a world where these limits need not apply.
ja: 遠い昔、人もアルセウスも持たなかった英知をもって、私たちはこれらの限界が適用されない世界へと創造を導ける。

key: FERN: Gotta say, I've never been so glad to see you.
en: FERN: Gotta say, I've never been so glad to see you.
ja: ファーン: あんたに会えてこんなにうれしかったことないよ。

key: FERN: Anyway, even you should get it now.
en: FERN: Anyway, even you should get it now.
ja: ファーン: とにかく、あんたも今ならわかるはずでしょ。

key: I'm only here because of you, \PN.
en: I'm only here because of you, \PN.
ja: わたしがここにいるのは、全部あんたのせい、\PN。

key: You got in the way of me just staying peacefully at school.
en: You got in the way of me just staying peacefully at school.
ja: あんたのせいで学校で平穏に過ごすことができなくなった。

key: You got in the way of me finishing the league.
en: You got in the way of me finishing the league.
ja: あんたのせいでリーグを終わらせられなかった。

key: And you got in the way of me stopping Team Meteor.
en: And you got in the way of me stopping Team Meteor.
ja: そしてあんたのせいでチームメテオを止められなかった。

key: FLORINIA: No action undertaken by \PN has prevented you from continuing to assist in countering Team Meteor.
en: FLORINIA: No action undertaken by \PN has prevented you from continuing to assist in countering Team Meteor.
ja: フロリニア: \PNの行動によって、あなたがチームメテオへの対抗を続けることが妨げられた事実はありません。

key: FERN: That's where you're wrong.
en: FERN: That's where you're wrong.
ja: ファーン: そこがあんたの間違い。

key: They steal all the glory in everything they do.
en: They steal all the glory in everything they do.
ja: あいつは何をやっても、栄光を全部かっさらっていく。

key: Whether it's luck or some other kind of bullshit, they always just happened to be at the right place at the right time.
en: Whether it's luck or some other kind of bullshit, they always just happened to be at the right place at the right time.
ja: 運なのか何なのか知らないけど、あいつはいつも都合よく正しい時に正しい場所にいる。

key: And there was none left for anyone else.
en: And there was none left for anyone else.
ja: そのせいで、他の誰にも何も残らなかった。

key: FLORINIA: This condition does not necessitate defection as an alternative.
en: FLORINIA: This condition does not necessitate defection as an alternative.
ja: フロリニア: その状況が、離反という選択肢を必要とするわけではありません。

key: FERN: What can I say? I got tired of hearing praise everywhere they went.
en: FERN: What can I say? I got tired of hearing praise everywhere they went.
ja: ファーン: しょうがないでしょ。あいつが行く先々で褒められるの聞くのに疲れたの。

key: Blacksteam Factory?
en: Blacksteam Factory?
ja: ブラックスチーム工場?

key: You think I didn't notice something was up there the first time I visited?
en: You think I didn't notice something was up there the first time I visited?
ja: 最初に行った時、何かおかしいって気づかなかったとでも思ってる?

key: Spinel Town?
en: Spinel Town?
ja: スピネルタウン?

key: I went back for the league and rumors about \PN were drifting around right alongside the stuff that was STILL being teleported about.
en: I went back for the league and rumors about \PN were drifting around right alongside the stuff that was STILL being teleported about.
ja: リーグのために戻ったら、まだテレポートで色々運ばれてる最中だったのに、それと一緒に\PNのうわさまで流れてた。

key: When I had the opportunity, I decided to go with the ones who actually gave me a chance.
en: When I had the opportunity, I decided to go with the ones who actually gave me a chance.
ja: 機会があった時、わたしは本当にチャンスをくれた側についただけ。

key: FLORINIA: It is only rational that \PN would have accepted any help that was offered.
en: FLORINIA: It is only rational that \PN would have accepted any help that was offered.
ja: フロリニア: \PNが差し伸べられた助けを受け入れるのは、合理的なことに過ぎません。

key: LIN: Absence can be a welcome relief.
en: LIN: Absence can be a welcome relief.
ja: リン: 不在は、時に歓迎すべき安らぎとなる。

key: FERN: \PN would only accept me being around them to use me for free healing between battles.
en: FERN: \PN would only accept me being around them to use me for free healing between battles.
ja: ファーン: \PNがわたしをそばに置いてたのなんて、バトルの合間にタダで回復させるためだけ。

key: That's the case for everyone, right?
en: That's the case for everyone, right?
ja: みんなそう思われてるんでしょ?

key: There's no gratitude there, and it doesn't matter what they think of the other person as long as they're of use.
en: There's no gratitude there, and it doesn't matter what they think of the other person as long as they're of use.
ja: そこに感謝なんてない。役に立つ限り、相手のことをどう思ってるかなんて関係ない。

key: FLORINIA: Utility is not the only benefit of cooperation.
en: FLORINIA: Utility is not the only benefit of cooperation.
ja: フロリニア: 協力の利点は、有用性だけではありません。

key: Individuals participating in mutually beneficial activities for the sake of the same goal often observe increased friendliness between them.
en: Individuals participating in mutually beneficial activities for the sake of the same goal often observe increased friendliness between them.
ja: 同じ目標のために互いに利益のある活動に参加する個人同士は、しばしば親密さが増す傾向が観察されます。

key: LIN: Victory shared is victory halved.
en: LIN: Victory shared is victory halved.
ja: リン: 分かち合った勝利は、半分の勝利。

key: FERN: Please.
en: FERN: Please.
ja: ファーン: はいはい。

key: \PN only cares about what others do for them.
en: \PN only cares about what others do for them.
ja: \PNは他人が自分に何をしてくれるかしか気にしてない。

key: Someone that's mute can't make friends anyway.
en: Someone that's mute can't make friends anyway.
ja: しゃべらない奴に友達なんてできるわけない。

key: FLORINIA: Appreciation can exist and be expressed independent of speech.
en: FLORINIA: Appreciation can exist and be expressed independent of speech.
ja: フロリニア: 感謝は、言葉を介さずとも存在し、表現されうるものです。

key: LIN: A gift has no value if not given.
en: LIN: A gift has no value if not given.
ja: リン: 贈られなければ、贈り物に価値はない。

key: FERN: Just because kindness can be silent doesn't mean silence is kind.
en: FERN: Just because kindness can be silent doesn't mean silence is kind.
ja: ファーン: 優しさが沈黙でありうるからって、沈黙が優しいとは限らない。

en: Or are you saying that's the best I can expect?
ja: それとも、それがわたしに期待できる精一杯だって言うの?

key: FLORINIA: That is not my intention, but--
en: FLORINIA: That is not my intention, but--
ja: フロリニア: そういうつもりではありませんが――

key: LIN: Neglect is the most kindness some can offer.
en: LIN: Neglect is the most kindness some can offer.
ja: リン: 放置こそが、一部の者にできる最大の優しさ。

key: FERN: That would make a lot of sense, seeing as you always ignored me in favor of your stupid textbooks.
en: FERN: That would make a lot of sense, seeing as you always ignored me in favor of your stupid textbooks.
ja: ファーン: それなら納得。あんたはいつもくだらない教科書を優先してわたしを無視してたもんね。

key: I must've really been awful for a bunch of paper to be more worthy of your attention than me.
en: I must've really been awful for a bunch of paper to be more worthy of your attention than me.
ja: 紙切れの束の方がわたしより注目に値するなんて、よっぽどわたしはひどかったんだろうね。

key: FLORINIA: One's interests are not exclusive to their regard for others.
en: FLORINIA: One's interests are not exclusive to their regard for others.
ja: フロリニア: 個人の興味関心は、他者への配慮と排他的なものではありません。

key: LIN: Motives do not erase a crime.
en: LIN: Motives do not erase a crime.
ja: リン: 動機は罪を消さない。

key: FERN: So you just hated me all on your own then, is that it?
en: FERN: So you just hated me all on your own then, is that it?
ja: ファーン: つまり、あんたは自分の意志でわたしを嫌ってたってこと?

key: Just like everyone else.
en: Just like everyone else.
ja: 他のみんなと同じように。

key: FLORINIA: The aforementioned thought pattern remains extremist and fatalistic.
en: FLORINIA: The aforementioned thought pattern remains extremist and fatalistic.
ja: フロリニア: 前述の思考パターンは、依然として過激かつ運命論的です。

key: LIN: Complicated words cannot blur a simple truth.
en: LIN: Complicated words cannot blur a simple truth.
ja: リン: 複雑な言葉で、単純な真実はぼやけない。

key: FERN: It IS extreme, isn't it?
en: FERN: It IS extreme, isn't it?
ja: ファーン: 過激なのは事実でしょ?

key: But I guess that's what you'll say I deserved.
en: But I guess that's what you'll say I deserved.
ja: でも、それがわたしにふさわしいって言うんでしょ。

key: It was the same with you and the same with everyone.
en: It was the same with you and the same with everyone.
ja: あんたも、他のみんなも同じだった。

key: FLORINIA: No one can say what another deserves.
en: FLORINIA: No one can say what another deserves.
ja: フロリニア: 他者にふさわしいものが何かを、誰も言うことはできません。

key: LIN: The bystanding witness is as guilty as the murderer.
en: LIN: The bystanding witness is as guilty as the murderer.
ja: リン: 傍観する証人は、殺人者と同じだけ罪がある。

key: FERN: If it wasn't what I deserved, then why didn't you do anything about it?!
en: FERN: If it wasn't what I deserved, then why didn't you do anything about it?!
ja: ファーン: わたしにふさわしくないなら、なんで何もしてくれなかったの?!

key: Was I not worth it to you, or did I just not even cross your mind in the first place?
en: Was I not worth it to you, or did I just not even cross your mind in the first place?
ja: わたしに価値がなかったの、それともそもそも眼中になかったの?

key: Forget or forsake me.
en: Forget or forsake me.
ja: 忘れたか、見捨てたか。

key: Which is it!?
en: Which is it!?
ja: どっちなの?!

key: FLORINIA: That is not a statement that can be answered...
en: FLORINIA: That is not a statement that can be answered...
ja: フロリニア: それは答えられる質問ではありません…

key: LIN: Because the answer is already known.
en: LIN: Because the answer is already known.
ja: リン: 答えはもうわかっているから。

key: FERN: You're disgusting.
en: FERN: You're disgusting.
ja: ファーン: 気持ち悪い。

key: Both of you.
en: Both of you.
ja: 二人とも。

key: We'll make a world where heartless people like you don't exist.
en: We'll make a world where heartless people like you don't exist.
ja: あんたたちみたいな心のない人間がいない世界を、わたしたちが作る。

key: FERN: I'm going ahead.
en: FERN: I'm going ahead.
ja: ファーン: わたしは先に行く。

key: These two can rot in here for all I care.
en: These two can rot in here for all I care.
ja: この二人はここで朽ち果てればいい。知ったことじゃない。
